name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer focused on the Lapon Canyon Gold Project in Nevada's Walker Lane gold trend, located approximately 40 miles southeast of Yerington. The company holds a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and an Exploration Stream Earn-in Agreement allowing it to earn up to a 50% interest by funding US$5 million in exploration. Nevada Canyon is in the explorer stage, with recent drill results returning 3.79 g/t Au over 85 metres and a maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate targeted for completion by end of 2026.
